goals: Verify that the webservice deployed by Docker Compose is accessible and responds with expected initial content.
Verify that the webservice deployed by Docker Compose correctly maintains and updates its internal state across multiple requests.
activities: Create a Docker Compose project instance.
Initialize the Docker Compose command interface.
Start Docker Compose services in detached mode.
Wait for 1 second for services to be ready.
Send an HTTP GET request to 'http://0.0.0.0:5000/'.
Assert that the response text is 'Hello World! I have been seen 1 times.\n'.
Send another HTTP GET request to 'http://0.0.0.0:5000/'.
Assert that the response text is 'Hello World! I have been seen 2 times.\n'.
Stop and remove Docker Compose services.
